record.category: backup storage / SFTP box (RAID-6, Enterprise HDD)

free_tier.stated: 250 GB $3/mo · 500 GB $4/mo · 1 TB $6/mo · 2 TB $11/mo. Germany (Falkenstein) and Finland (Helsinki) sold as separate product groups.

egress.terms: "Unmetered Traffic" with "1 GBit/s" port, on both the DE and FI product pages. This is the cleanest egress term among the records read. A port speed with no counter and no published fair-use threshold.

record.tooling: rsync/Borg/restic over SSH. No S3, no WebDAV.
record.chaining: Archive/backup leg only. No object API means it cannot serve the hot set or back a Cloudflare origin directly.
record.limits_note: WebDAV and S3 protocols are not supported. Storage plans cap at 2 TB per server instance.
record.reliability_note: Hosting provider advertises 256 GB RAM Xeon E5-1650v3 storage nodes with RAID-6 arrays and unmetered 1 Gbit/s network links. Promotional discounts are reported on hosting forums but unverified at checkout without placing an order.

evidence.proved: "Please check our Storage plans: ... and use the coupon code: LET50% to get a recurring annual 50% discount" (NetDynamics24 Host Rep account)

record.price_per_tb_month: List: $6.00/TB/mo at 1 TB, $5.50/TB/mo at 2 TB. With LET50% on annual: 1 TB = $30/yr = $2.50/TB/mo; 2 TB = $55/yr = $2.29/TB/mo. at 5 TB: three 2 TB boxes = $2.29/TB/mo. at 20 TB: same $2.29/TB/mo but requires ten boxes. Unmetered 1 Gbit/s is the reason to care.
